Common questions

How do I recover guest progress?

Guest progress is tied to your device. Upgrade to a registered account (email, with Apple and Google sign-in coming) as early as possible so your career is saved and syncs across devices.

How do refunds work?

In-app purchases are handled by Apple or Google. Refund requests are processed by the relevant store under its policies. Your non-excludable statutory rights are unaffected — see the Terms, clause 6.

How do I report a bug or a cheater?

Email admin@fourxgames.com. Please don't exploit bugs — report them and we'll fix them.

How do I delete my account?

See the account deletion page for in-game and web instructions.
